en.headline: Housing Bureau says 70 per cent of subdivided flats registered for grace period
en.dek: The bureau told the legislature that 75,070 units in about 21,000 flats have been registered, with nearly half in Kowloon, covering most of the estimated 110,000 citywide.
body: The Housing Bureau said on Wednesday that about 70 per cent of Hong Kong’s subdivided flats have been registered for a three-year grace period under the Basic Housing Units Ordinance.

In a written reply to the Legislative Council, Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said 75,070 subdivided homes across roughly 21,000 whole flats had been registered since applications opened in March. Of those, 49,100 are in Kowloon, including 21,500 in Yau Tsim Mong district.

Ho said the figure represented about 70 per cent of the 110,000 subdivided flats identified in an earlier survey. She described the progress as satisfactory, noting that most owners or operators were seeking the grace period to plan next steps for their properties.
The bureau has also received applications from about 250 subdivided flats for recognition as basic housing units, with 53 approved so far, according to the same reply.

zh.headline: 房屋局：約七成分間單位已登記寬限期
zh.dek: 局方向立法會表示，約 21,000 個單位內的 75,070 個分間單位已登記，其中近半位於九龍，涵蓋全市估計約 11 萬個的大部分。
body: 房屋局星期三表示，香港約七成分間單位已根據基本住宅單位條例登記三年寬限期。
房屋局局長何永賢在書面回覆立法會時指，自三月開始接受申請以來，約 21,000 個整幅單位內的 75,070 個分間單位已登記。其中 49,100 個位於九龍，包括油尖旺 21,500 個。
何永賢表示，這數字約為先前調查所得 11 萬個分間單位的七成。她形容進度令人滿意，指大部分業主或營運者正尋求寬限期，以便為其物業規劃下一步。
同一回覆並指，局方亦已接獲約 250 個分間單位申請認可為基本住宅單位，其中 53 宗已獲批准。
